description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Mishra's Warform's ability.
Resolve both Mishra's Warform abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn, and repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.
